techParks.name: Wipro SEZ Sarjapur
techParks.description: Wipro's global corporate headquarters campus on Sarjapur Road at Doddakannelli, about 1 km south of the Sarjapur-ORR junction: the SJP1 corporate office plus the adjoining SJP2 SEZ development centre. Owner-occupied; the Azim Premji Foundation sits next door. Polygon from OSM way/370327479 with SJP2 at way/230229162.

techParks.name: Wipro Kodathi SEZ
techParks.description: Wipro's second Sarjapur Road campus, a 50-acre SEZ at Kodathi village about 6 km south-east of the HQ, planned at ~2 million sq ft for 30,000+ staff when announced in 2018 and listed on Wipro's locations page as the Kodathi Development Center (Survey No. 91/1, 98 & 99). Polygon from OSM way/635317794.

techParks.name: RGA Tech Park
techParks.description: A 2.2 million sq ft, four-block IT/SEZ park on Sarjapur Main Road at Chikkanahalli village near Carmelaram (Plot 13-15), developed by the Kolkata-based RGA group. Listings place Uber and PayPal in Blocks 1-2, Siemens in Block 2, Unisys and LTTS in Block 3 and Accenture in Block 4; RGA's own client list adds HP, Intuit, Societe Generale, Capgemini and Genpact without mapping them to blocks. Cerner/Oracle Health and Visa were NOT found here. Polygon from OSM way/460960666.

techParks.name: Prestige Ferns Galaxy
techParks.description: Prestige Group office complex on the Outer Ring Road at the Sarjapur Road junction, Bellandur, opposite Salarpuria Softzone. OSM maps a Microsoft office and an IndiQube Edge coworking centre inside it; no tenant list could be verified against Prestige's site (403). Polygon from OSM way/639884725.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Softzone
techParks.locality: Bellandur / Green Glen Layout, Sarjapur-ORR junction
techParks.description: Multi-block Salarpuria Sattva office complex (Blocks A/B, Nos. 80/1, 81/1, 81/2) on the ORR service road at Green Glen Layout, Bellandur, beside the Sarjapur Road junction. PhonePe's registered HQ (Block A) and JFrog India (B Block) are confirmed from their own sites; OSM additionally tags HSBC, Dell, Genpact, SAP, National Instruments, AT&T and Brocade here, unverified. Polygon from OSM way/232329241.

techParks.name: Vaishnavi Tech Park
techParks.description: Three-tower (North/Central/South) Vaishnavi Group office park on Sarjapur Main Road just south of the ORR junction at Bellandur Gate; Groww's headquarters is in the South Tower. Polygon from OSM way/1084971895.

techParks.name: Vaishnavi Tech Square
techParks.description: Vaishnavi Group office building on the ORR at Iblur junction, west of the Sarjapur Road flyover. OSM places Navi Technologies inside it; the developer's site lists no tenants. Polygon from OSM way/1167872058.

techParks.name: Intel SRR Campus
aliases: Intel India Sarjapur Ring Road campus
techParks.description: Intel's owner-occupied 44-acre campus on the Outer Ring Road ('Sarjapur Ring Road') between Global Technology Park and RMZ Ecoworld, Bellandur, with buildings SRR1-SRR5; the 620,000 sq ft SRR4 design house (Rs 1,100 crore) opened in 2017 and the site is Intel's largest design centre outside the US. Polygon from OSM way/232892803.

techParks.name: Sattva Spectrum
techParks.description: New Grade A office tower by Sattva Group 'next to Wipro office on Sarjapura Road' at Kaikondrahalli, listed as an ongoing project on the developer's commercial page; the only 2024-26 Sarjapur Road campus that could be verified. No tenants announced. Polygon from OSM way/1089707942.

techParks.name: Bharat IT Park
techParks.description: Small office campus on Sarjapur Main Road at Ambalipura (Haralur side), between Bellandur Gate and Kaikondrahalli; OSM names it 'Zepto HQ-Bharat IT Park'. Developer and size unknown. Polygon from OSM way/1389761625.

techParks.name: Mantri Commercio
techParks.description: Twin-tower Mantri office block on the ORR at Bellandur next to Sobha's corporate office and Sakra hospital. Tenants listed are OSM-mapped only (Rapido Office, Replicon 'Tower B 5th floor', JDA/Blue Yonder, a Flipkart Internet node) and not verified against company pages. Polygon from OSM way/320455185.

coverageNotes: Search budget: the shared WebSearch quota ran out after about ten queries, so verification after that was by direct fetch of company/developer pages and offline OSM data; several company sites blocked fetches (Meesho, Navi, Zepto, Prestige, Vaishnavi commercial, Würth, IndiQube, NoBroker footer), which is why those entries are marked low or medium. Lens items NOT confirmed and left out: Oracle Health/Cerner and Visa are not at RGA Tech Park (OSM puts Cerner at Mountain Ash, Manyata and Visa at Bagmane WTC - other lenses); Byju's, Ather Energy (IBC Knowledge Park, Bannerghatta Rd per OSM) and Ola Electric (Koramangala/HSR per OSM) have no substantiated Sarjapur-side office; Infosys has no verified Sarjapur Road campus; L&T Tech Park is on Bellary Road in north Bengaluru, not in this lens (covered via LTTS's office); Swiggy's ETV address could not be read first-hand so it is omitted; Honeywell appears in OSM beside Intel/RMZ Ecoworld but no company page confirmed it. OSM-only tags deliberately not promoted to companies: HSBC, Dell, Genpact, SAP, National Instruments, AT&T and Brocade at Salarpuria Softzone; Safran Engineering Services at Primeco The Hub (Sarjapur Rd, Iblur); Replicon, Blue Yonder and a Flipkart node at Mantri Commercio; Uber and Instakart nodes on Sarjapur Road/ORR; Azim Premji Foundation (NGO) next to Wipro. PayPal: listings put it in RGA Blocks 1-2 but OSM tags 'PayPal Bengaluru' at Pritech Park on the Bellandur ORR, so its current site is uncertain. Quess House (Bellandur Gate) and eMudhra's Devarabeesanahalli office may no longer be occupied since both companies now list other HQs. Geography: no substantiated corporate offices were found in Haralur (other than Bharat IT Park), Kasavanahalli, Carmelaram (other than RGA), Dommasandra, Gunjur or Varthur; OSM maps a 'Prestige Tech Habitat' commercial plot at Varthur (12.931,77.740) and coworking centres (discourse.work at Sarjapur, BuzzWorks at Varthur) that could not be verified and were left out of techParks. New 2024-26 campuses: only Sattva Spectrum (next to Wipro, Kaikondrahalli) is confirmed from the developer; Prestige, Embassy and Bagmane Sarjapur Road plans could not be checked. Wipro's EC5 SEZ unit is listed by Wipro but has no separate geometry so only EC4 is mapped. Flipkart (ETV), Simple Energy (Yelahanka), Quess Tower, Rapido HSR, Wipro Enterprises (Koramangala), eMudhra (Aerospace Park), LTTS Bellary Road and Narayana Health (Bommasandra) are outside this lens's geography but were learned en route and included per rule 7; Narayana is classed MID_SIZE as the brief instructed despite 19,000+ employees. Flipkart's origin is given as Foreign because its parent (Walmart) is US-headquartered. Headcounts: no source stated a Bengaluru-specific headcount for any company, so bengaluruEmployeesApprox is null throughout.
